title: Whole Vault Approach and Side Ring Practice Layout
description: One static gymnastics-apparatus preparation layout, three complete existing models and zero new independent models. At left a whole curved-deck springboard is aligned along the long floor direction before a complete broad-head vault table, with a real separated gap rather than inferred mechanical connection. At right an entire independently guyed twin-ring portal occupies a separate tall hanging-apparatus zone. All original GLB geometry, normals, hierarchy, fixed poses and complete PBR remain at unit scale, translated only. One scene-only floor connects the separate approach and side apparatus areas. This is neither a raised boxing enclosure with bag stations nor the old barbell-and-bench or rower-and-treadmill corner. No model component is extracted, duplicated or counted as new. Static illustrative equipment preparation only: no functional compatibility of board/table, actual run-up length, landing provision, training routine, user fit, load, stability, certified clearance or safety claim. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
